items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: another one, Frisco --John Bingham. I'll never forget these people gave me wisdom

ctx.x: So, I went to an old hotel, the number was 13, Rue (inaudible). And the number was 11, before it was 13 -- rents had gone up -- inflation -- then I went to see some old friends and one person, one of them was Gene Bullard.

He was the most fascinating individual I have ever met and another one, Frisco --John Bingham. I'll never forget these people gave me wisdom and then this Gene, he came and he was from Georgia somewhere he became a colonel in the Foreign Legion and it seems as though years ago, Gene and some of those caucasians down there had a little trouble and seems like someone said, get him, and it seemed like he left like 12 or 13 dead in the cornfields and made it, made it to France and joined the Foreign Legion and when…
He seemed to have been so bad and rough that he became colonel in the Foreign Legion.
